_meta.not_computable_rule: 2026-11-11: a required window is classed not computable (key soft_face_locking, compatibility name) only when the stick-memory window AND the production-law restart of the same checkpoint both stopped before an evaluation point; the first-increment pattern alone is noted (first_increment_pattern) and no longer vetoes a fallback; designs built from identical decks list each other under replicates
_meta.set_precedence: per window the highest-ranked set in SETS wins: physio_fric5 (stick-memory law, PI 2026-11-09) supersedes physio_fric3 (production law, NUM-13 artefact); physio_relG (process G, PI 2026-11-10 option a) holds the 27 insertion-stopped designs; physio_relG_pl is a fallback source only (production law on the G checkpoint, + margin, flagged); the insertion-stopped scans: physio_fric3 then physio_relG
